items.summary: CFO recommendation: maintain financial containment. Do not authorize new spend, paid acquisition, production expansion, or new monetization work this cycle. Delivery is saturated at 10/10 slots and 57 improvements remain in measurement. Revenue support is insufficient: Amazon reported 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 commission for 2026-09-21; all commission is in aggregate tracking ID "other", so site revenue, ROI, and causal lift are unsupported. The September 2026 AI bill is $1,002.46 across 5,531 calls, including 234 errors, but it cannot be compared to the one-day revenue window. Complete or close the existing saveusfarms.com repair case by 2026-10-01T09:00Z, then execute only the canonical allthingsmasonic.com CTA refinement after capacity release.

Financial disposition: treat contribution margin, payback, cost-to-learn, site-level revenue forecasts, and causal-lift claims as unknown. The available evidence supports $0 site-attributed commission and $4.92 aggregate unattributed commission for 2026-09-21. Contribution margin is not calculable because infrastructure/hosting, domains, labor, paid marketing, and other operating costs are absent, and the revenue and AI-cost periods do not match. The minimum finance-grade measurement is a period-matched ledger by site and content identifier containing affiliate clicks, ordered and shipped items, commission, AI cost, infrastructure/hosting, domains, paid marketing, and allocated labor.

After the existing capacity gate clears, preserve only the canonical allthingsmasonic.com CTA refinement. Measure outbound affiliate clicks and eligible sessions for 14 days against the existing 61-click 2026-09-21 baseline. Do not use clicks, sessions, conversions, or impressions as revenue or margin proxies; do not claim ROI or causal lift without site-attributed commission and period-matched cost evidence.

AI and infrastructure exposure: September AI usage cost was $1,002.46, with $20.49 assigned to fleet overhead and materially concentrated spend including 0daynews.com at $155.90, americastrikes.com at $110.27, and blackmarketapparel.com at $67.71. These are AI costs only, not contribution margins. Infrastructure, hosting, domain, labor, and paid-marketing exposure are not present in the snapshot, so budget exposure and cost-to-learn cannot be calculated. Recommend report-only reconciliation before any incremental spend.
